references.text: Jesus gives further instructions on how the disciples should handle rejection in cities or homes they visit, building upon the instructions given in verse 11.
Luke provides a parallel account where Jesus sends out the seventy and gives them similar instructions to find a worthy house and stay there.

The example of Lydia opening her home to Paul and his companions after becoming a believer illustrates the principle Jesus taught his disciples.
